review.notes: Structure scan of the whole OCR markdown: all 61 code-fence pairs are balanced under the exporter's toggle rule, no fence swallows numbered headings, tables or image embeds, and the prompt-box '#'-prefixed lines all sit inside Appendix C fences as printed. Automated droppage scan of all 50 physical pages (condensed-text window containment): hits triaged to the arXiv cover stamp (p1, not reader content), figure-internal axis ticks (p18 and others, present inside embedded figures), HTML table cell-order differences in the results tables on pp.13-17 (spot-verified present with matching values, e.g. MMMU 78.11), and Appendix C.1 prompt templates serialized as txt fences whose word order differs from the printed 'Image Question:' layout (entries verified present per benchmark, e.g. Omni-OCR, CC-OCR, BLINK). Real defects: one dropped Final Answer box body (Case 2 on p35), one Final Answer body promoted to a section heading (Case 3 on p36), and one bold run-in lead promoted to a section heading (p11). All three were verified on 200 dpi renders. Reference cross-check: every arXiv identifier and DOI printed on the reference pages is present in the OCR. Body pages 1-20 received the droppage scan plus targeted render verification; pages 21-50 (references, author list, appendices) received the machine scan and identifier cross-check, with case-panel and fence regions inspected around each defect; equations on pp.7-9 were not glyph-verified.
